`in-cell-images.xlsx` was generated independently with XlsxWriter 3.2.9 using
`embed_image` (Excel Place in Cell) and `insert_image` (Place over Cells).
The Products sheet is second, image insertion order differs from row order,
two cells share one JPG, and PNG/JPG cell pictures coexist with a floating PNG.
All pictures are tiny synthetic test images.

Format reference: https://xlsxwriter.readthedocs.io/worksheet.html#worksheet-embed-image
